title: Muraja'ah: Al-Muddaththir with Al-Qiyamah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 31. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ (١) قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ (٢) وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ (٣) وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ (٤) وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ (٥) وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ (٦) وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ (٧) فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ (٨) فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ (٩) عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ (١٠)

فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ (٤٩) كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ (٥٠) فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ (٥١) بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ (٥٢) كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ (٥٣) كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ (٥٤) فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ (٥٥) وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ (٥٦)

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of Al-Muddaththir 74:1-56 in register order.
questions.a: 74:1-56 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Recital rota: today's group recites Al-Muddaththir 74:1-56 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest section and log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your target in the portal response box. Start: 'In my next recital I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'In my next recital I will make the saktah in 75:27 without a breath.'

questions.q: Which comes first in the mushaf?
Think again: Al-Muddaththir ends 'He is worthy of fear and worthy to forgive' (74:56) and Al-Qiyamah begins with the Day. How do the two connect?
questions.a: Both warn about the Hereafter; one ends with Allah's forgiveness, the next opens with the Day when all will stand before Him.
